text: Slice 14 is Codex on chosen projects (PRD 5.5): a project picks its coding agent, Codex or Claude Code, and the factory runs Codex under the same rules, limits, view and records as Claude Code. It leaves the roadmap's Later row. #153 is its PRD, the first to go through the factory end to end: its plan of eight issues is ratified, and the factory works it once it takes ratified plans (#148).
